description: Sam's apartment block above the transit depot.
Ruth's camp on Alder Street. Safe, fenced, and short on everything.
A repair shop and a residential street. The garage is chained shut.
A jammed highway overpass and the Gas-N-Go below it.
Pharmacy, laundromat and a discount store.
Where Jo was working when the city fell. Too far to walk.
The only bridge across the river to Northgate.
lockedText: The Tollmen hold the bridge. (Act 2 — coming in a later version.)
